## Goal
- Deploy V6.10 fix to production so IVX IA executes real senior-developer pipeline (code→test→commit→deploy→verify) after owner approval, then build and upload fresh APK v1.9.0.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- App is **Expo Go (React Native)**, NOT Swift
- User demands honesty — do NOT claim VERIFIED without production proof
- `github_commit_multi_file` API: `action` + `confirm: true` + `confirmText` at TOP LEVEL, `files` + `commitMessage` inside `input`; `confirmText` must be `"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"`; gzip-base64 via `contentEncoding` field on EACH file entry
- Correct deploy endpoint: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`
- Owner auth: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` → `accessToken`; token expires in ~1hr
- Backend deploys via GitHub commit + Render auto-deploy; deploy takes ~2-3 min after commit
- `npx` NOT allowed — use `bun x`; `bun test` for validation
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` not available — must use backend's `github_commit_multi_file` API
- Production API returns HTTP 429/502/503 when rate-limited — add `sleep 2-3` between calls
- Interactive bash/python commands subject to 60s timeout — use `setsid` + background for long tasks
- **Sandbox clears /tmp files between sessions** — save test scripts to project `tmp/` directory instead
- IVX IA API response format: returns `status: "ok"`, `answer`, `provider`, `model`, `selectedIntent`, `deploymentMarker` at top level
- Test matching logic must use **OR matching** (any one keyword matches = pass)
- Health markers are TOP-LEVEL keys in `/health` response, NOT inside `healthMarkers` dict
- APK gradlew must run from `expo/android/` directory
- `node_modules` NOW persists in `expo/` (resolved since V7.0.2 session)

## Progress
### Done
- **V5 through V8.0.1** — all previously deployed
- **V8.0.1 deployed live** — commit `0ce1b755efb7`, boot `2026-07-31T13:21:18.019Z`, status=healthy; V8.0 markers present
- **V8.0 20-step acceptance test: 20/20 PASS (100%)** — verified on production (previous run)
- **V6.10 code changes IMPLEMENTED and DEPLOYED:**
  - Added `isOwnerExecutionActionType()` + `detectExplicitDeployAuthorization()` to `backend/services/ivx-owner-conversation-state.ts`
  - Added `executeOwnerAuthorizedDeveloperAction()` nested helper in `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` (~line 6110) — enqueues persistent senior-developer worker (classify → enqueue → poll → format → persist → return)
  - Wired state machine approval block: if `isOwnerExecutionActionType(resolved.actionType)` and approved → calls `executeOwnerAuthorizedDeveloperAction(resolved.originalQuestion)`
  - Wired state machine classification block 2b: if `isOwnerExecutionActionType(classified.actionType)` + explicit auth → executes immediately; otherwise creates pending action + asks for confirmation
  - Updated `resolveOwnerDevelopmentActionIntent` regex (`hasChatOrUiTarget`) to include `typ(?:ing|e|ed)?`, `indicator(?:s)?`, `live\s+status`, `read\s+receipt(?:s)?`, `status\s+bubble(?:s)?`
  - Added `renderTypingHeader` useMemo in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` — shows typing indicator bubble when `aiReplyPending` is true, rendered as `ListHeaderComponent` on the inverted FlatList
  - Added `typingHeaderContainer` style, updated `typingIndicator` style with `alignSelf: 'flex-start'` and `marginLeft: 12`
- **V6.10 version bump DONE:**
  - `expo/app.config.ts`: version "1.9.0", buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_31_V610_REAL_SENIOR_DEV_LIVE_TYPING`, buildTimestamp `2026-07-31T14:00:00.000000+00:00`
  - `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: versionCode 88, versionName "1.9.0"

- **V6.10 DEPLOYED to production via 3 commits:**

  - Import fix: `64933547dafdf810024b99f3bbbca7fad3dd2734` (added missing `isOwnerExecutionActionType` + `detectExplicitDeployAuthorization` imports in `ivx-owner-ai.ts`)

- **V6.10 end-to-end verification DONE (2026-07-31T14:30Z):**
  - Turn 1: "add live typing in this chat real time, deploy live" → returns real senior-developer worker status: TASK ID `ivx-worker-daefd910-f627-4fc0-a52a-449ef50cf909`, STATUS: RUNNING (committing, 65%), Provider: `ivx_self_developer_runtime` — NO LONGER crashes or returns canned confirmation
  - Turn 2: "Confirm do it" → returns coherent deployment-aware response based on current production state — NO LONGER re-runs last property query
- **V6.10 20-step acceptance test: 19/20 PASS (95%)** — run on 2026-07-31T14:31:51Z; Step 9 FAIL is intentional (authorization gate now correctly asks "Do you authorize me to run this end-to-end?" instead of auto-executing)

- Need to upload new APK to temporary host

### Blocked
- APK build may time out at 60s bash limit — may need `setsid` background run
- iOS build — no macOS/Xcode in sandbox
- Physical Android device QA — no emulator available
- APK download links expire within ~24h
- Pre-existing TS errors (NOT blocking deploys): `hono.ts:311,1292` duplicate `handleGetAuditTrail`, `hono.ts:4033,4085` `createService client` not found, type definition files for 'bun'/'node' not found

## Key Decisions
- V6.10 fix: conversation state machine now executes deployment/code-change actions via the same persistent worker queue used by `self_developer` route
- When owner explicitly says "deploy live", "do it now", "hazlo ahora", "confirm do it" → `detectExplicitDeployAuthorization()` returns true → executes immediately
- When owner asks for a feature without explicit deploy authorization → creates pending action + asks "Do you authorize me to run this end-to-end?" → "Confirm do it" resumes and executes the stored action
- "typing" added to `hasChatOrUiTarget` regex so "live typing" classified as `implementation_task` (real execution) instead of `public_deploy` (canned confirmation)
- TDZ fix: removed forward reference to `existingAIRequest` (not yet initialized at that point in `executeOwnerAuthorizedDeveloperAction`) by setting `assistantMessageId = null` directly
- V8.0 autonomous loop: `self_improvement` chat route calls `runIVXSeniorDeveloperTask` with `systemMode: true` (bypasses per-step approval gates)
- State machine intercepts owner-ai requests BEFORE the `LLM_TEXT_RESPONSE` route
- Read-only database questions execute directly against Supabase `jv_deals` table, never routed to LLM
- Property table priority: `jv_deals` first (3 deals), `properties` second
- Test keyword matching uses OR logic since answers are bilingual
- Pre-existing TS errors are NOT blocking deploys

## Next Steps
1. **Complete APK v1.9.0 build** — re-run `./gradlew assembleRelease` from `expo/android/`, verify new SHA-256 differs from `b06e13f34...`
2. **Upload APK** to tmpfiles.org or similar temporary host
3. **Update plan file** with APK evidence (SHA-256, download URL, size)
4. Run broader QA test suite (1,000 tests from owner directive)
